# Cloud conventions

## Semantic:
- Always derive names of resources from the Azure Cloud Adoption Framework's abbreviations list: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/cloud-adoption-framework/ready/azure-best-practices/resource-abbreviations
- If no appropriate abbreviation exists, then derive one from examples present in the working directory's files, repository or notes.
- For now, AWS and GCP examples are omitted. If similar official abbreviation lists exist, those should be referenced.
